ambiguities.aspect: Priority between load and Rule 90 advance
readings: On a clock edge with load=1, q is synchronously loaded with data and the Rule 90 update is suppressed, so q_next = data.
On a clock edge with load=1, the system is loaded with data and then immediately advanced by one Rule 90 step, so q_next = rule90(data).
No reset or initial value is specified, so q is unknown/X before the first load and stays X if load is never asserted.
q is implicitly initialized to all zeros at power-up or before the first clock edge, so it evolves from the all-zero state if load is never asserted.
